mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.reservation_no, r.source_type, r.status, r.version, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM reservation_line l WHERE l.reservation_id = r.id) AS line_count, (SELECT min(lower(l.planned_range)) FROM reservation_line l WHERE l.reservation_id = r.id) AS check_in, (SELECT max(upper(l.planned_range)) FROM reservation_line l WHERE l.reservation_id = r.id) AS check_out, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM reservation r WHERE ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}
